obligations.expected_behavior: When a frozen historical file is written, the system rejects any mutation to its historical bytes.
forbidden_result: Historical file mutation is accepted or persisted.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated blob-comparison fixture reports rejection when historical bytes differ.
obligations.state_before: A frozen file write is attempted with mutated historical bytes.
obligations.subject: FR-5 historical bytes
obligations.trigger: Frozen file write with changed historical bytes

obligations.expected_behavior: When the historical validator reference is inspected, its identity remains auditable and is validated against the recorded validator blob.
forbidden_result: Validator identity cannot be audited or the inspected blob is accepted without identity verification.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated validator-blob fixture produces an auditable validator identity result.
obligations.state_after: Historical validator identity is auditable from the validator blob.
obligations.state_before: The historical validator reference is inspected.
obligations.subject: FR-5 historical validator
obligations.trigger: Reference inspection of the historical validator

obligations.expected_behavior: When original command evidence has been altered, the system rejects the alteration.
forbidden_result: Altered original command evidence is accepted as valid.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated command-mutation fixture reports rejection of altered command evidence.
obligations.subject: FR-5 original command
obligations.trigger: Detection of altered original command evidence

obligations.expected_behavior: When a wrapper has not been launched, the system rejects the replay as invalid for lack of launch.
forbidden_result: A replay with no wrapper launch is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated no-launch fixture reports rejection.
obligations.state_after: Replay without wrapper launch is rejected.
obligations.subject: FR-5 wrapper replay
obligations.trigger: Replay attempt with no wrapper launch

obligations.expected_behavior: When replay identity does not match the bound identity, the system rejects the replay.
forbidden_result: A replay with an identity mismatch is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated binding-mutation fixture reports replay rejection.
obligations.state_before: Replay binding contains an identity mismatch.
obligations.subject: FR-5 replay binding

obligations.expected_behavior: When historical data is promoted as authoritative handoff state, the system rejects the promotion.
forbidden_result: Historical data is promoted into authoritative handoff state.
obligations.observable_result: An isolated forged-handoff fixture reports rejection of the promotion.
obligations.state_after: Promotion of historical data to authoritative handoff is rejected.
obligations.state_before: Historical data is presented for promotion to authoritative handoff state.
obligations.subject: FR-5 authority limit
obligations.trigger: Attempt to promote historical data as authoritative handoff
